requirements.summary: Merge Profile and Wallet pages into a single unified Profile page displaying user info, QMY/ICP balances, vesting breakdown, transaction history, and simulated send card with yellow borders and yellow text styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Navigating to /profile (or equivalent route) shows user info and wallet content on the same page
QMY balance, ICP balance, vesting breakdown, transaction history, and simulated send card are all visible on the Profile page
No standalone wallet route (/wallet) exists or is linked in navigation
Yellow borders and yellow text styling are applied consistently
Unauthenticated users see a login prompt

file_operations.description: Merge wallet content from WalletPage.tsx into this unified Profile page. Include all wallet UI elements: QMY balance display using useQMYLedger hook, ICP balance display using useICPLedger hook, VestingBreakdown component, QMYTransactionHistory component, and SendQMYSimulatedCard component. Preserve existing ProfileGlassPanel styling with yellow borders and yellow text. Maintain authentication guards and registration flow. Arrange content in a logical vertical layout with appropriate spacing.

Mark this file as deprecated or convert it to redirect to /profile route, since all wallet functionality is now embedded in the unified Profile page. Remove this page from active use but keep the file for reference during the transition.

Remove or comment out the standalone /wallet route registration. Ensure navigation links point to /profile for both profile and wallet access. Update any breadcrumb or navigation logic to reflect the unified Profile page.
Update navigation links to remove any standalone 'Wallet' or 'Carteira' link if present. Ensure 'Profile' or 'Perfil' navigation item remains and points to /profile route.

requirements.summary: Restore and complete the Central Bank page to publicly display all QMY supply data, XP totals, bonus distributions, monster counts, and recent transactions synced from Carteira A canisters using existing hooks and canister IDs.
acceptanceCriteria: Central Bank page is accessible without authentication
Page displays: coin supply breakdown, circulating vs. locked tokens, vesting info, XP totals, bonus distributions, monster counts, and recent transactions
All data is fetched from the Carteira A canister IDs already configured in the project
Yellow text and yellow-bordered glass panels are used consistently
No layout or color changes are introduced to other pages

file_operations.description: Expand this page to display comprehensive public data from Carteira A canisters. Use the existing useLuxuryBank hook to fetch total supply, circulating coins, locked/vesting coins. Add calls to useARGameData or useQueries hooks to fetch XP totals, bonus distributions, and monster counts aggregated across all players. Display recent transaction summaries using the existing QMY transaction hooks. Organize data into yellow-bordered ProfileGlassPanel components or similar styled cards. Ensure the page is publicly accessible without authentication checks. Maintain the existing yellow-on-dark glassmorphism visual style from the current dashboard.

requirements.summary: Ensure all Leaflet OpenStreetMap map pages display coin and monster marker positions synced with Carteira A canisters using existing hooks and actors without altering map layout or styling.
acceptanceCriteria: Map page renders coin and monster markers using data from the Carteira A canisters
No new canister IDs are introduced; existing configured IDs are used
Map layout, zoom, tile layer, and styling are unchanged

file_operations.description: Verify that the map page uses the useMapMarkers hook to fetch live coin and monster marker data from the Carteira A canisters. Ensure markers are rendered correctly on the Leaflet map instance. Confirm that no hardcoded static markers override canister data unless the canister returns empty results (in which case fallback is acceptable). Do not modify map configuration, tile layers, zoom settings, or styling. Confirm map is synced with the same canister IDs already used elsewhere in the app.
